goal: Sign on, then look up the given member and read their name, savings balance and checking balance
description: Signed on as <redacted>, navigated to Member Inquiry, looked up member 40021, and read their name (R. ACHTERBERG), savings balance (4,210.55), and checking balance (812.03).

params.name: member_no
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

steps.intent: Start the task by loading the application
Enter the member number to look up

target.why: Enter the member number to look up

success_template:
# frame: navFrame
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "MERIDIAN":
      - cell "MERIDIAN"
    - row "Main Menu":
      - cell "Main Menu":
        - link "Main Menu":
          - /url: /menu
          - img "Main Menu"
    - row "Member Inquiry":
      - cell "Member Inquiry":
        - link "Member Inquiry":
          - /url: /lookup
          - img "Member Inquiry"
    - row "Sign Off":
      - cell "Sign Off":
        - link "Sign Off":
          - /url: /content
          - img "Sign Off"
# frame: workFrame
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
      - cell "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - row "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
              - cell "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2"
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "MEMBER RECORD Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out} Transfer Funds":
      - cell "MEMBER RECORD Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out} Transfer Funds":
        - text: MEMBER RECORD
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - row "Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out}":
              - cell "Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out}":
                - table:
                  - rowgroup:
                    - row "Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out}":
                      - cell "Member No. {member_no} Name {out} Status ACTIVE Branch MAIN Savings Bal. {out} Checking Bal. {out}":
                        - table:
                          - rowgroup:
                            - row "Member No. {member_no}":
                              - cell "Member No."
                              - cell "{member_no}"
                            - row "Name {out}":
                              - cell "Name"
                              - cell "{out}"
                            - row "Status ACTIVE":
                              - cell "Status"
                              - cell "ACTIVE"
                            - row "Branch MAIN":
                              - cell "Branch"
                              - cell "MAIN"
                            - row "Savings Bal. {out}":
                              - cell "Savings Bal."
                              - cell "{out}"
                            - row "Checking Bal. {out}":
                              - cell "Checking Bal."
                              - cell "{out}"
        - link "Transfer Funds":
          - /url: /transfer?no={member_no}
          - img "Transfer Funds"
